changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwprocedurepricelist AS SELECT ppl.id, ppl.procedure_id, ppl.price, ppl.currency, ppl.created_by, ppl.created_date, ppl.last_modified_by, ppl.last_modified_date FROM public.procedure_price_list ppl;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwprocedurepricelist TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwprocedurepricelist FROM report_user;
